name: Core Browser
description: Native Chromium browser automation, HTTP requests, and extraction helpers
author: OAIY Team

defaultMode.label: Default Session Mode
defaultMode.description: Default browser session mode. Chromium uses the bundled engine and CDP; WebView uses the Tauri embedded view; HTTP is plain fetch.

defaultUserAgent.label: Default User Agent
defaultUserAgent.description: Default user agent string for requests

engineChannel.label: Browser Engine Channel
engineChannel.description: Which managed Chromium channel to track

engineAutoCheck.label: Check for engine updates
engineAutoCheck.description: Periodically check for new managed Chromium builds

engineAutoDownload.label: Auto-download engine updates
engineAutoDownload.description: Download new engine builds without asking. Bundled engine always stays as a fallback.
